subject: Participate in Google User Research
snippet:
Hello from Google! 👋  
 
 We're conducting user research for Gmail and we'd really value your opinions and insights.
 
 We have some questions that we're looking for your feedback on. If you're interested in helping us, you can apply to join the study by clicking the button below to get started.
